missed.fact: Reminder has two columns the map omits: `uid` (unique cross-device identity for the §9.4 snapshot merge, with a unique index) and `deletedAt` (soft-delete tombstone). All columns are id, uid, entryId, offset, anchorTime, deletedAt. A merge must union by uid and let a tombstone win. There is no updatedAt, because ReminderDao has no update path.

ReminderOffset is a sealed class with two subclasses, FromPreset(Preset) and Custom(count, IntervalUnit). The Preset enum has 7 cases: ONE_HOUR, TWO_HOURS, FOUR_HOURS, EIGHT_HOURS, ONE_DAY, TWO_DAYS, ONE_WEEK. Custom units are only DAY, WEEK and MONTH (MONTH is approximated as 30 days), so there is no minute unit and no custom hours. Sub-hour offsets cannot be created. The offset is stored as one string in the snapshot, 'PRESET:<name>' or 'CUSTOM:<count>:<unit>', which a merge must parse.
The offset is packed into a single string on the wire, 'PRESET:<enum>' or 'CUSTOM:<count>:<unit>'. The decoder quarantines unknown presets, units or arity via undecodable().

anchorTime is ignored whenever the Entry has a startTime. Firings use entry.startTime ?: reminder.anchorTime ?: MIDNIGHT. The sheet stores null when the entry has a start time. The anchor also covers a middle day of a multi-day EVENT, per the Reminder KDoc.
A reminder on an entry with no startDate never fires, because nextOccurrenceDate returns null when startDate is null. The sheet has no guard against adding one (needsAnchor only checks startTime).

Recurrence is armed for one occurrence at a time, and only for a recurring EVENT with RecurrenceRule.Fixed, where the next future occurrence is used. A recurring TASK (Elastic) anchors to entry.startDate and its reminders use that date. The next occurrence is re-armed when this one passes (the sweep or the desktop replan).
Reminders do not fire for a trashed entry, or for a TASK whose status is not PENDING. An EVENT has no status, so its pre-due reminders still count. Nothing at or before now is returned.
A TASK also owes a separate OVERDUE firing at start date + time (midnight if no time). It is not a Reminder row and has no entry in the reminders table. FiringKind is OVERDUE, REMINDER or HABIT.

The Android notification goes on the shared TASKS_EVENTS channel at IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT with setAutoCancel(true). There is no per-reminder sound, repeat or nag field, and no acknowledge action on reminder notifications. Only the overdue notification has Done and Skip actions.

The only UI entry point is ReminderSheet(entry), opened from a bell on an Entry row in Calendar and Tasks. The bell is hidden when the reminderSheet slot is null. ReminderViewModel.add is the only production code that creates a Reminder, apart from sync merge and archive restore.
Habits have a separate reminder mechanism (Habit.time, habitFiring, FiringKind.HABIT, HabitReminderAlarmReceiver). It is not a Reminder row and has no entryId.
ReminderDao has no update path, only insert and softDelete. Merge rules can therefore treat reminders as immutable once created: a uid is inserted once and tombstoned once.

Reminder.anchorTime is stored as null when the entry has a real start time, and null otherwise means midnight. So anchorTime is only non-null for reminders added to a no-start-time entry where the user picked an anchor.
